verses.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਨ ਵੰਞੈ ਸਾਹੁਰੇ ਸਿਖ ਲੋਕ ਸੁਣਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: aap na va(n)n(j)ai saahure sikh lok sunaavai|

en.bdb: The Guru prevaricator is similar to a girl who herself goes not to the father-in law's house and gives precepts to others.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੰਤੁ ਨ ਪੁਛੈ ਵਾਤੜੀ ਸੁਹਾਗੁ ਗਣਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: ka(n)t na puchhai vaataRee suhaag ganaavai|

en.bdb: Her husband never cares for her and she sings paeans of her happy married life.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚੂਹਾ ਖਡ ਨ ਮਾਵਈ ਲਕਿ ਛਜੁ ਵਲਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: choohaa khadd na maaviee lak chhaj valaavai|

en.bdb: It is such as the rat itself cannot enter the hole but roams tied winnowing tray to its waist.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮੰਤੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਅਠੂਹਿਆ ਹਥੁ ਸਪੀਂ ਪਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: ma(n)t na hoi aThoohiaa hath sapee(n) paavai|

en.bdb: It is such a person as not knowing even the mantra of a centipede lays his hand on a snake.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਰੁ ਸੰਨ੍ਹੈ ਆਗਾਸ ਨੋ ਫਿਰਿ ਮਥੈ ਆਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: sar sa(n)nhai aagaas no fir mathai aavai|

en.bdb: The person who facing towards sky shoots the arrow receives the arrow on his own face.
The apostate is yellow faced, frightened in both the worlds and repents.
